title: Embedded console manifest v1
description: manifest.json written beside the copied console tree and embedded with it (docs/specs/server-runtime.md section 6). Sorting by path and path uniqueness are semantic checks the server and the release verifier repeat.

path.description: Release builds section 5.1 member paths: slash-separated segments that start with an ASCII letter or digit, continue with letters, digits, underscore, dot, plus and hyphen, do not end in a dot and are at most 240 bytes, at most 32 segments and 1,024 bytes; the one exception is the exact path .vite/manifest.json. Windows device names are a semantic check
